after.zh: 先横后竖，九次乘加变成六次。核能拆成一行乘一列时就能这样省，这叫可分离滤波；核越大省得越多。
after.en: Horizontal first, then vertical: nine multiply-adds become six. You can save like this whenever a kernel splits into a row times a column. This is separable filtering; the bigger the kernel, the more you save.

t.zh: <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref>和<level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref>只看左右或上下，这一关看一整圈：每格换成它周围 3×3 九个格子的平均。横竖一视同仁，叫方块模糊。
t.en: <level-ref to="1-1"></level-ref> and <level-ref to="1-2"></level-ref> looked only left and right, or up and down; this one looks all the way round: each cell becomes the average of the nine cells in the 3×3 block around it. Horizontal and vertical are treated alike, and this is called a box blur.

t.zh: 这一关多了一项限制：计算量，数的是每算出一个输出格子要做几次乘法和加法。一张手机照片有上千万个像素，视频每秒几十张，每格省一次，总数就省下很多。
t.en: This level adds a limit: the cost, which counts how many multiplications and additions it takes to compute one output cell. A phone photo has over ten million pixels and video runs at dozens of frames a second, so saving one operation per cell adds up to a lot.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：做出 3×3 平均，计算量不超过 6。最直接的搭法会超标，你得找一种更省的算法。
t.en: Your task in this level: make a 3×3 average with a cost of no more than 6. The most direct circuit goes over the limit, so you need to find a cheaper method.

caption.zh: 一个亮点，期望是被摊成 3×3 的一小块
caption.en: A bright dot: the expected output spreads it into a small 3×3 block

brief.zh: 每个像素换成它周围 3×3 九个格子的平均。计算量不能超过 6。
brief.en: Replace each pixel with the average of the nine cells in the 3×3 block around it. The cost must not exceed 6.

hint.zh: 九个格子挨个加要 8 次加法。3×3 的方块，能不能拆成几步更小的平均？
hint.en: Adding up nine cells one by one takes 8 additions. Can the 3×3 block be split into a few smaller averages?
